mappings.rationale: Pi 1.2.0's change to this surface is #10769: wheel input no component handles scrolls the transcript even when an overlay has focus. It is ported on int-120 (f408ae3367, ReviewCodingAgent's b082ab29ad: handleWheel no longer defers to a focused overlay; TestAltScreenScrollsOnWheelAFocusedOverlayDoesNotHandle red before). The keyboard bindings are unchanged and covered by the alt-screen keyboard tests and scenario fullscreen/02.
